title: Observation
dueSectionText:
SCAN-DUE

Due-check results come from a provider-content fingerprint comparison, not an LLM judgement — it can only tell you a task's scanned content changed, never whether the change matters. It is a backstop, not a guarantee.

Checking due-ness reads live task content but never calls a model — scanning does.

The estimate below is a 30-day historical mean, not a quote — actual per-scan cost can vary. Abort stops the queue and releases the browser; scans already sent will finish, bill, and may still raise a ruling. Scans this queue runs are judged behind the same Principle 0 gate as any other
